title: Rendlesham Forest Incident (1980)
summary: A famous UAP case involving U.S. Air Force personnel stationed near RAF Woodbridge in England.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: In December 1980, military personnel reported unusual lights and encounters near Rendlesham Forest, close to RAF Woodbridge.

sections.heading: Military Witnesses
sections.content: The case gained attention because several witnesses were trained military personnel who documented the incident through statements and recordings.

sections.heading: Legacy
sections.content: Rendlesham remains one of the most discussed UAP cases in the United Kingdom.
